info.title: Pakperk API
info.description: Stable v1 paper-reading API with optional OIDC-backed account profiles, synchronized To Read libraries, and moderated flat paper comments. Comment publication has an independent emergency kill switch which preserves reads and safety controls.

delete.description: Repeat-safe author deletion. Request bodies are rejected; COMMENT_CREATION_ENABLED does not disable deletion.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the shared mutation window resets

patch.description: Replaces the authenticated author's comment body using optimistic version concurrency. The comment-creation kill switch does not disable author edits.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the shared mutation window resets

post.description: Creates or returns the authenticated user's canonical report. Report detail never appears in the response or diagnostics.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the shared account or origin window resets

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity tag returned by an earlier response for the same feed query

ETag.description: Opaque validator for this feed query and representation

304.description: Feed representation has not changed; response body is empty

get.description: Registered only when ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=true; the route is absent when the account feature is disabled.

200.description: Current account profile and terms state

ETag.description: Strong profile validator in the form quoted profile-N

delete.description: Registered only when ACCOUNT_DELETION_ENABLED=true. Every request, including an identity-scoped replay, requires recent authentication. The verified issuer/subject is the replay key; no Idempotency-Key header is accepted. A replay resumes durable externalization and returns the original operation. ACCOUNT_DELETION_UNAVAILABLE is unusual: the account is already locally deletion_pending, ordinary access remains blocked, and the worker/operator owns completion even though the external tombstone was not yet acknowledged durable.

202.description: Deletion accepted or identity-scoped replay; clients must immediately clear credentials and account-owned local data

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST when the DELETE body is non-empty or any Idempotency-Key header is supplied

429.description: RATE_LIMITED for a new operation only; identity-scoped replays never consume quota

503.description: ACCOUNT_DELETION_UNAVAILABLE proves post-commit local disable and asynchronous ownership. SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is ambiguous and never asserts acceptance. Clients fail closed for either response after dispatch.

patch.description: Registered only when ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=true; the route is absent when the account feature is disabled. Updates use an exact strong profile ETag for compare-and-swap.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Required exact strong profile validator returned by GET /v1/me

requestBody.description: Supported profile fields; explicit null clears only display_name

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_PROFILE_VERSION, INVALID_PROFILE_UPDATE, INVALID_HANDLE, INVALID_DISPLAY_NAME, INVALID_TERMS_VERSION, TERMS_VERSION_MISMATCH, INVALID_COMMUNITY_GUIDELINES_VERSION, or COMMUNITY_GUIDELINES_VERSION_MISMATCH

get.description: Newest-first account-owned block list with opaque cursor pagination.

put.description: Idempotently blocks a public comment author. The authenticated comment view filters that author immediately and durably.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the shared mutation window resets

delete.description: Idempotently removes a user block. Request bodies are rejected.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the shared mutation window resets

get.description: Newest-first comments owned by the authenticated account, including private pending-review status.

Registered only when ACCOUNT_DELETION_ENABLED=true. Resolves a verified OIDC identity to a bounded existing account record without JIT provisioning. This endpoint intentionally accepts a currently valid access token regardless of auth_time; DELETE /v1/me alone enforces recent authentication.

200.description: Existing account identity used to bind the destructive confirmation flow

get.description: Lists the active To Read set. Registered only when ACCOUNTS_ENABLED and LIBRARY_ENABLED are both true. This metadata-only route never schedules paper preparation.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Required exact state; v0.0 accepts only to_read

200.description: Newest-saved active items fenced to one account revision; complete convergence with a changes pass

get.description: Returns active records and removal tombstones in ascending committed revision order for the authenticated account. Other accounts never advance this watermark. Registered only with accounts and library enabled; it never schedules preparation.

parameters.name: after_revision
parameters.description: Required last fully applied revision for the authenticated account

410.description: LIBRARY_SYNC_RESET_REQUIRED; replace the local account library from the full list before resuming changes

put.description: Saves a paper to To Read. Registered with accounts and library enabled; LIBRARY_WRITES_ENABLED can independently return FEATURE_DISABLED without removing reads.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required client operation UUID; must exactly match body operation_id

requestBody.description: Strict To Read save intent; unknown fields are rejected

200.description: Canonical current library record; exact replays return the same current record

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the shared write window resets

delete.description: Removes a paper from To Read by writing a synchronization tombstone. The header is the complete mutation intent; request bodies are rejected.

200.description: Canonical removal tombstone; exact replays return the current canonical record

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the shared write window resets

get.description: Newest-first published comments. Guests receive the public view; an authenticated view additionally applies durable blocks. Registered only when COMMENTS_ENABLED=true.

200.description: Published comments visible to this guest or viewer

401.description: A supplied bearer token is invalid or expired

post.description: Creates one normalized flat comment. COMMENT_CREATION_ENABLED can reject only this operation while preserving reads and all safety controls.

requestBody.description: Strict comment intent; client_request_id is the durable idempotency key

example.body: The ablation changes how I read the main result.

200.description: Exact idempotent replay of the canonical comment

201.description: Canonical accepted comment, published or privately pending review

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the shared account or origin window resets

post.description: Creates or returns the authenticated user's canonical report about a public user. Reporting is independent from blocking and never changes comment visibility.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Local public user ID to report

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the shared account, target, or origin window resets

ProfileUpdateBody.description:
Supported compare-and-swap fields for `PATCH /v1/me`. All properties are
optional, while an explicit JSON null is meaningful only for
`display_name`.

oidcBearer.description: OIDC access token validated against the configured issuer, audience, algorithm, and JWKS.
